title: Server-held job access policy
description: Versioned server-held ACL stored separately from immutable job execution-policy snapshots. Job, tenant, issuer-qualified owner, and initial base visibility are bound at creation. The v1 selected group ID is scoped to owner_subject.iss; a group-path reader must authenticate under that same issuer and currently belong to the exact group. The only v1 base-visibility change is audited, conditional narrowing from okta_group to submitter through the dedicated revoke-group operation; a group cannot be switched or restored. Reader-grant updates cannot change base visibility. Current Okta group membership and tenant eligibility are rechecked at read time. Reader subjects never gain manage rights.

owner_subject.description: Server-derived dashboard submitter (exact verified iss, sub); identical to the job policy user_subject.

reader_subjects.description: Explicit named individual grants; only unexpired, unrevoked entries with the requested action authorize. The API verifies each subject belongs to the job tenant. Empty at version 1. Removal writes a separate append-only audit record; no grant confers cancel or ACL-management rights. Subjects must be unique, enforced by the API.
